test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

But this immortality / will have purchased / at the price of / his immortal part.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is** segment 1: "will have purchased".**
 
• The correct verb tense to use in this sentence is "will have been
